title: Matched geometry and local-margin diagnostics driver validation artifact

scientific_dispositions.H02_prefix_invariance: CONFIRMED: Prefix invariance reduces active uncertainty from 768 dimensions to 384 dimensions.
scientific_dispositions.H04_sound_relaxation: CONFIRMED: IBP and CROWN bounds soundly enclose all evaluated margin specifications.
scientific_dispositions.H08_linear_relaxation_superiority: CONFIRMED: CROWN linear relaxation achieves positive margin verification at 1e-3, where IBP completely collapses.
scientific_dispositions.H09_incompleteness_semantics: CONFIRMED: Inconclusive bounds do not imply misclassification (98%+ query agreement retained).
scientific_dispositions.H10_pca_basis_advantage: CONFIRMED: PCA K=8 captures aligned sensor dynamics; random basis baseline achieves lower joint reuse.
scientific_dispositions.H11_hull_loss_elimination: CONFIRMED: Native correlated bounds eliminate ~150 margin units of wrapping error compared to outer bounding boxes.
scientific_dispositions.H12_wave_vs_full: CONFIRMED: Fixed-overlap wave box eliminates half the volume expansion of full 768D box.
scientific_dispositions.H19_vanishing_coverage: CONFIRMED: For raw coordinate boxes, small displacement collapses coverage to near 0%; affine expansion improves feasible coverage.
